_comment: FiveM AutoIt macros shown in the Scripts tab. The server lists every .au3 file in scriptsDir live (newest-modified first) and detects whether each is running by matching AutoIt process command lines. 'descriptions' maps a filename to the blurb shown on its card; files with no entry get a generic fallback. AGENTS: update descriptions here (not server.js) when a script's behavior changes; update scriptsDir/autoItExe only if the folder or AutoIt install moves.

descriptions.nLoop.au3: Taps the N key every 5 seconds. Starts 3s after launch. In-game keys: - pause, = resume, ] stop.
descriptions.eLoop.au3: Taps the E key (interact) every 5 seconds. Starts 3s after launch. In-game keys: - pause, = resume, ] stop.
descriptions.newTrapLoop.au3: Presses M every 4 seconds, with a 4/5 key sequence every 30 minutes. Press ] to stop.
descriptions.mLoop.au3: Presses M every 4 seconds and runs a periodic 4/5 + M restock sequence on the half hour. Press ] to stop.
descriptions.harvestDrugs.au3: Drug-harvest loop: taps E in a timed pattern (E, wait ~15s, E). Toggle on/off in-game with the / key.
descriptions.sellCloneCards.au3: Sells clone cards: holds E, clicks, nudges the mouse and clicks again on a ~11s cycle. Toggle with \, ESC to exit.
descriptions.pressKeynew.au3: Heartbeat key every 4s; every 5 min checks the death pixel and auto-leaves (F8 - quit - Enter) if you've died.
descriptions.pressKey.au3: Presses a key every 4s with a 5-minute death-pixel check that quits the session if you're dead.
descriptions.leaveWhenDead.au3: Watchdog: if the death pixel (887,930 = #333333) holds for 10s, sends F8 - 'quit' - Enter to leave. Press ] to stop.
descriptions.selling.au3: Selling loop: waits for the confirm color, then presses Tab - Enter to sell. Press ] to stop.
descriptions.sellBOTH.au3: Launcher that starts selling, mLoop and leaveWhenDead together. In-game: 9 start, - pause/resume, 0 stop.
descriptions.cookingorig.au3: Cooking loop: hold E, click, move + click, Tab x3, Enter, then wait for the ready pixel. Keys: - start, = exit, [ pause.
descriptions.cooking.au3: Cooking loop with a restock step (types amounts, clicks menus) after each cook. Keys: - start, = exit, [ pause.
descriptions.m.au3: Simple loop: presses M every 3 seconds. Press [ to stop.
descriptions.pixelchecker.au3: Utility: shows the mouse position and the pixel color under the cursor. ESC or = to exit. Use it to find coords/colors for other scripts.
